topics.label: Applied AI
topics.blurb: Models inside a real system: science, production apps, evals, and the code around them.

topics.label: Agentic AI
topics.blurb: Agents that do a job: coding agents, long runs, skills, and tool use.

topics.label: Harness engineering
topics.blurb: The loop, sandbox, memory, and checks around a model. The model is one part of the system.

topics.label: RLVR
topics.blurb: Reward is a checker. Math, code, and any answer you can verify, which is how reasoning models are trained.

topics.label: RL environments
topics.blurb: The task, the world, and the score. Prime Intellect’s environments and verifiers, and OpenEnv.

topics.label: Reinforcement learning
topics.blurb: Policy gradients for language models. GRPO, rollouts, and a post-training run that updates the weights.

topics.label: Demos
topics.blurb: Someone at the keyboard, showing a system they use or built.

topics.label: News
topics.blurb: What just changed, from people who will say it plainly.

topics.label: Training
topics.blurb: How a model actually gets built: data, loss, parallelism, scaling, post-training.

topics.label: Inference
topics.blurb: Kernels, KV cache, attention, quantization, and serving.

topics.label: Deep learning
topics.blurb: The mechanics: gradients, architectures, attention, the stuff underneath the API.

topics.label: Vision-language
topics.blurb: A vision encoder tied to a language model. CLIP’s contrastive picture, Flamingo, then LLaVA.

topics.label: Talks
topics.blurb: Long technical talks and interviews with the person who did the work.

topics.label: Releases
topics.blurb: Research releases, told by the people who shipped them.

cs336.title: Language Modeling from Scratch
cs336.blurb: Percy Liang and Tatsunori Hashimoto. You implement the tokenizer, the transformer, the kernels, the data pipeline, and alignment. This is the spine of the library.

z2h.title: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
z2h.blurb: Spelled out, in code, from micrograd to a reproduced GPT-2. Watch in order.

cs224n.title: NLP with Deep Learning
cs224n.blurb: Christopher Manning’s course, trimmed to the lectures that still earn their time: vectors, networks, transformers, post-training, evals, agents.

mit.title: Introduction to Deep Learning
mit.blurb: A one-week map of the field from Alexander Amini and Ava Soleimany. Foundations, then the 2025 core lectures. Sponsor slots are not included.

3b1b.title: Deep learning, visually
3b1b.blurb: Grant Sanderson. The pictures you want in your head before the code.

scratch.title: Coded from scratch
scratch.blurb: Paper, math, then a PyTorch implementation. Transformers, LLaMA, FlashAttention, quantization, LoRA, DPO.

harness.title: Harness engineering
harness.blurb: The machinery around an agent: context, the loop, the sandbox, long-running state, and a receipt for what actually ran. Watch in order.

gpumode.title: GPU MODE
gpumode.blurb: A cut of the GPU MODE lecture series: inference, attention, quantization, numerics, multi-GPU. Not the whole channel.
